# 🔊 Soundboard

> **Status: Actively in development** — core feature bug fixes in progress; visual overhaul, additional features, and final polish pending.

A cross-platform soundboard app built with Flutter, targeting Android and iOS. Load your own audio files, organize them into buttons, and control playback with precision — whether you need overlapping layers or clean, isolated one-at-a-time playback.

## Features

- **Custom sound import** — load any audio file from your device directly into the board  
- **In-app recording** — record audio on the spot and add it to the board instantly  
- **Play / Pause / Stop** — per-button playback controls  
- **Sound overlapping** — press a button multiple times to layer several instances of the same audio playing simultaneously  
- **Sound isolation** — restricts playback to one sound at a time, preventing interference between buttons  
- **Stop All** — halt all active sounds at once  
- **Drag-to-reorder** — rearrange sound buttons on the board by dragging

---

## Tech Stack

| Framework | Flutter (Dart) |
| :---- | :---- |
| Platforms | Android, iOS, Windows |
| State Management | Riverpod |
| Audio Playback | just\_audio |
| Audio Recording | flutter\_sound |
| File Import | file\_picker |
| Local Storage | Hive |

---

## Project Structure

lib/

├── main.dart        \# App entry point and initialization

├── models/          \# Data models (sound entries, board state)

├── providers/       \# State management (Riverpod)

├── screens/         \# Top-level UI screens

├── services/        \# Audio playback, file handling, recording, and settings

├── theme/           \# App-wide styling and theme definitions

└── widgets/         \# Reusable UI components

---

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- [Flutter SDK](https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/install) installed and configured  
- An Android or iOS device / emulator

### Run locally

git clone https://github.com/PassiveTryHard/soundboard.git

cd soundboard

flutter pub get

flutter run
